meta.title: Catch And Tame traits data

machine.rerollBehavior: Rerolling removes the pet's current traits.

meta.notes: The standalone wiki lists six Trait Machine outcomes with chance percentages. Fandom cross-checks the six trait names, effects, $1M building cost, 3-10 sacrifice pet requirement, 3-trait maximum, and reroll replacement behavior.

items.name: Money Boost
items.effect: Increases the pet's earning rate by 1.2x.
items.bestUse: Best on high-BPS pets that stay in your pen for steady cash generation.
items.sourceStatus: Standalone wiki chance; Fandom effect cross-check
items.imageStatus: text-only; Fandom image rejected as a before/after pet screenshot, not a clean trait icon

items.name: Hatch Speed
items.effect: Increases egg hatch speed by 25% when the pet is placed in the pen.
items.bestUse: Useful on pets kept near egg production because it reduces waiting time between hatch cycles.
items.sourceStatus: Standalone wiki chance; Fandom effect cross-check
items.imageStatus: text-only; no clean source-backed trait icon found

items.name: Breed Luck
items.effect: Increases breeding luck by 25%, improving hatch quality.
items.bestUse: Strong on breeder pets when you are trying to improve egg outcomes over repeated cycles.
items.sourceStatus: Standalone wiki chance; Fandom effect cross-check
items.imageStatus: text-only; no clean source-backed trait icon found

items.name: Mutation Luck
items.effect: Increases the chance of a bred egg hatching into a mutated pet by 20%.
items.bestUse: Best when your goal is mutation hunting through breeding rather than immediate cash income.
items.sourceStatus: Standalone wiki chance; Fandom effect cross-check
items.imageStatus: text-only; no clean source-backed trait icon found

items.name: Twin Eggs
items.effect: Gives a high chance to produce two eggs instead of one after each breed cycle.
items.bestUse: Pairs well with breeder pets because more egg output gives more chances at useful hatch results.
items.sourceStatus: Standalone wiki chance; Fandom effect cross-check
items.imageStatus: source-backed Twin Eggs effect image cropped/optimized from Fandom Traits

items.name: Rideable
items.effect: Allows the player to mount and ride the pet across the map.
items.bestUse: Best on a pet you actually keep and move with, especially when crossing islands or returning to your pen.
items.sourceStatus: Standalone wiki chance; Fandom effect cross-check
items.imageStatus: source-backed saddle trait icon cropped from Fandom Traits row image
